title: Livery tenant
description: Settings of one tenant. The folder name is the tenant id and the first segment of its URLs. @livery/tokens validates the same rules at build time.

tokens.description: The tenant folder whose tokens.json styles this tenant. Defaults to its own.

locale.description: Canonical BCP 47 locale for numbers and dates, such as en-GB.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, such as GBP.
